notes: Step 1 parts were correct; no parts added or removed.

Circuit: 5V -> top + rail -> wire to column 6 -> photoresistor (col 6 to col 10) -> col 10 node (A0 via blue wire) -> 10k resistor (col 10 to col 13) -> black wire to GND rail -> Arduino GND. This matches the schematic voltage divider.
In the image the f-j half is at the top, next to the top rails. I mapped it to catalogue bank 'b' (rows f-j), with the top rails as tp (+) and tn (-).
Rail hole indices (tp.1, tp.5, tn.3, tn.11) are estimated from the image pixel positions. Any hole on the same rail is electrically equivalent.
The black GND wire goes to the second GND pin on the Arduino power header. I used GND.1, since the catalogue does not say which header pin that is. All GND pins are the same net.
The photoresistor legs are in row g, the resistor in row h, and the blue and black wires in row i. Row letters within a column strip are equivalent.
